Burgers and grill

Burgers and grill dishes as on the menu in the Google listing, prices in euro, all taxes included. Burgers come with signature coleslaw, pickles and French fries; the beef is 100% homemade USDA Angus, as a 180 g or 250 g patty. More starters, salads, the kids menu and desserts are on the full menu.

From the grill

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A burger grill on the road to Cape Greco

The Black Bull Burger and Grill sits on Leoforos Protara-Kavo Gkreko 360 between Protaras and Cape Greco: an open kitchen, a terrace with string lights and the bull’s head on the sign. In the menu’s own words: homemade Angus burger, 100% homemade USDA Angus beef, served with signature coleslaw, pickles and French fries. On Google, guests mention the burgers, the fries, the coleslaw and the spare ribs most often.

Open every day from one in the afternoon until ten at night.

What guests say

Two of 754 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.

“Very tasty food! We had the Jack Burger and the halloumi salad, both super delicious! The kids got things to draw with and we were offered a patio heater, very attentive!”
Kasia · Google review
“Excellent burger, friendly service. Had the Black Bull burger 250g, which includes pulled pork as a topping (that mostly spills out as you try to eat). It was a lot of meat, and a filling meal, though priced accordingly. Ample free parking in the field just to the south.”
Kenn L. · Google review
